title: Using Smart Planner
description: Turn intervals and usage into one prioritized schedule.

steps.text: Open More → Smart Planner (or the Planner tab).
Review what's due now, upcoming, and seasonal.
Tap a task to see its details and related manual pages.
Mark tasks complete as you do them.

tips: The plan adjusts to your usage, region, and season.
Pro adds manual-derived intervals and predictive recommendations.
affects: Boat Health Score, reminders, and seasonal readiness.
examples: Seeing the impeller is due this month.
